description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class for managing employee membership data in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, searching, counting, and deleting employee membership records via a data access object.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage employee membership data, acting as an intermediary between controllers and the data access layer.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeMembershipDao instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeMembershipDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership entity by employee number and ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for employee memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Gets the total count of employee memberships matching the filter.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee memberships by IDs.
